title: Director, Inventory Management & Operational Excellence
text:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

The Director, Inventory Management & Operational Excellence will lead a new enterprise team that brings inventory back to plan and keeps it there. The role installs a standard inventory management system at Teledyne sites: control of the material coming in, sound stocking policy and planning, and regular reviews that turn data into decisions. The Director leads the program and works hands-on at one site at a time, starting in our defense businesses.

A key part of this role involves partnering with Segment leadership, site General Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to set standard work, build site capability, and deliver sustainable business results, supporting enterprise objectives for working capital, on-time delivery, and margin.

**This role requires up to 75% travel. Due to the extensive travel involved, candidates may be based anywhere within the United States.**

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead standard site assessments of planning maturity, part-level inventory, and forecast accuracy, and partner with site leadership to prioritize and execute improvement opportunities.
* Set and deploy baseline standard work for every site, including weekly action on MRP messages for open purchase orders, receiving to plan, monthly inventory forecast reporting, and documented decisions on excess, obsolete, and aged WIP inventory.
* Drive inventory optimization and working capital improvement initiatives across the organization. Lead tactical controls on open purchase orders and receipts first, then structural fixes to safety stock, min/max settings, inventory entitlement, and planning.
* Own the guiding metric: material and labor going into inventory vs. cost of goods shipped, tracked monthly and forecast a year ahead, so sites act before inventory builds.
* Establish and implement enterprise inventory policies, standards, and governance, including decision rights for buying ahead of demand, keeping excess, and disposing of obsolete material.
* Run the monthly enterprise inventory review with senior leadership, using KPI dashboards to monitor every site, identify gaps, and drive accountability.
* Co-lead each site’s weekly material exception review and monthly General Manager inventory review, then coach site leaders to run them on their own.
* Strengthen SIOP, demand forecasting, and make-to-stock or make-to-order decisions with site planning teams, from opportunity identification through implementation and sustainment.
* Leverage AI-enabled technologies, automation, and advanced analytics to improve inventory decisions, reporting, and business performance.
* Capture what works at each site in a standard playbook and share best practices across the enterprise.
* Lead and develop a team of one Manager and two Inventory Analysts working two sites at a time.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of leadership experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Materials Management, or Operational Excellence, including site-level operations or supply chain leadership.
* APICS CPIM or CSCP, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, preferred.
* Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing and global business environments.
* Ability to travel up to 75%, including extended on-site periods during site engagements, to work with site teams, run operational reviews, and develop site leaders across Teledyne business units.

**Qualifications and Competencies**

* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives and deliver measurable inventory and working capital results.
* Deep knowledge of materials management and supply chain planning, including MRP, open purchase order management, safety stock and inventory policy, SIOP, and demand forecasting.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Standard Work, and Root Cause Problem Solving.
* Experience deploying and sustaining business systems or enterprise operating models across multiple sites or business units, with hands-on factory and supply chain experience.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Passion for continuous improvement, emerging technologies, AI-enabled business transformation, and operational excellence.

* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills, including leading site teams without direct authority.
* Experience utilizing KPI dashboards, operational scorecards, and performance management systems.
* Experience working in ERP systems (SAP preferred) and across multiple ERP environments.

**Due to the type of work performed and facility access requirements, applicants must be a "U.S. Person" (U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee).**

**Salary Range:**

$170,900.00-$227,900.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.
